summary.text: Tiffany Stoner is a Democrat running again for Indiana House of Representatives District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican Becky Cash.
A small-business owner and military spouse, she lost the 2024 race for the seat to Cash by 64 votes.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Stoner was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and graduated from Hinsdale Central Township High School.
Ballotpedia lists a graduate degree in communications sciences from Ball State University in 1994.
Her career experience includes work as a network architect and senior program manager for Accenture and as owner of a commercial photography business.
Stoner was the Democratic nominee for District 25 in 2024, when Cash won 18,794 votes to Stoner's 18,730.
She advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with no opponent.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small-business owner, military spouse and mother of four, and named quality education, affordability for families and thriving communities as her priorities.
She also said she has hosted monthly Library Chats across the district and favors disclosure and local say in data center projects.
